disease_label_per_paper: Fatal differentiation syndrome complicating acute promyelocytic leukemia treatment
presentation_summary: 42-year-old woman presented with severe vaginal bleeding, dizziness, fatigue, bruising, and pancytopenia.
Initial vitals were afebrile with normal oxygen saturation, but labs showed anemia, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, and DIC.
During ATRA/ATO induction she developed rising WBC, gingival bleeding, headache, abdominal pain, fever, respiratory distress, pulmonary vascular congestion, AKI, lactic acidosis, and cardiac arrest.
Infectious disease evaluation and gram-negative blood-culture growth created DS versus sepsis overlap.
Confirmatory PML-RARA/FISH/flow evidence is stored separately.
